title: The Fourth, 2017 · the shirt, again
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Two days after: a stranger's stick-figure shirt on the dock rail, damp, ten years after the first one, and Gully looking at the high shelf where the first one still is, and putting this one in the bin. Wood sees a rule get made. The strip doesn't say what the rule is.

panels.composition: The dock rail with a damp T-shirt on it, a stick figure printed on the front. The PUP sniffing it.

panels.composition: GULLY looking up at the high shelf inside: the thermos, the tin, the flag, the lantern, a folded shirt from 2007.

panels.composition: GULLY dropping the new shirt in the bin.

panels.composition: WOOD on the steps, having seen a rule made.

notes: One shirt kept, one binned. The rule not said.
